items.title_orig: The most difficult people you miss
items.article_text:
It’s coming up on the one year anniversary of my dad passing away and I never could have predicted how I feel right now. I didn’t think I’d be the kind of person still stuck in grief that has to resist making it a core part of their being. For context, he was a pretty unrepentant addict until he got really sick. He was manipulative, controlling, quick to anger, and extremely judgmental. We had a difficult relationship in which I had to put a lot of distance between us to regain some semblance of normalcy. 
 It was pretty evident with the lifestyle he was living he wouldn’t be long for this world and I did everything I could to emotionally prepare for the very real possibility he’d pass away. And yet, it still doesn’t feel real in some ways. More so than that, the crazy thing is I miss him.
